integrity: The precise width-one claim has a complete constructive proof and a standalone deterministic finite-field consistency checker; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite abelian groups of odd order and coefficient fields containing a primitive root of unity of order equal to the group exponent. Nonsplitting and modular characteristic cases are not settled. Commutator subalgebra dimension is already known from group-ring transport; new contribution is width one.
title: Single-commutator realization in Fourier-split core quandle algebras
